Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No. 2320 of 2022
Sunil Kumar ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
Present:-
 Mr. Navnish Negi, Advocate for the applicant.
 Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. for the State.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant Sunil Kumar is in judicial custody in Case Crime No.01 of 2022, under Sections 376, 506
Ipc and Sections 3(1)(r)(s) & 3(w)(i) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of
Atrocities) Act, 1989, Thana/Patti Maundarsyun-04, District- Pauri Garhwal.

He has sought his
release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant enticed the victim and raped her, due to which, she became pregnant.
When the mother of the victim noticed the pregnancy of the victim, she questioned the victim.
Thereafter, the victim revealed that the applicant forcibly raped her, due to which, she became pregnant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that, in fact, the parties are in consensual relationship; there have been no force, as such; the victim is a grown up woman.

Reference has been made to the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 ("the Code").
5.
Learned State Counsel would submit that in her statement under Section 164 of the Code, the victim has stated that she was forcibly raped by the applicant.

But, he admits that in her statement under Section 161 of the Code, the victim has told it to the Investigating Officer that she was in relationship with the applicant, but there also, according to learned State Counsel, the victim revealed that she was raped forcibly.

sentences.text: 6. Without much adverting to the merits, having considered the facts and circumstances, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
